Lumina is the only granddaughter of [[Romana (DS)|Romana]]. She lives with her grandmother and their butler [[Sebastian (DS)|Sebastian]] in the Villa, which is located in the north west part of town. Although Lumina comes from a wealthy home, she's hardly rude, and is very well mannered and kind. Lumina spends a lot of time playing the piano, and her grandmother one day hopes that she will be a famous pianist. When she's not practicing the piano, she likes to walk to the Goddess Pond or the beach during sunny weather. On rainy or snowy days, she will instead go to socialize at the Inner Inn. Lumina's childhood friend [[Rock (DS)|Rock]] will be your rival for her affection. Stew, Boiled Spinach, Pizza, Vegetable Juice, Pickled Turnips, Pickled Cucumber |horror =Elli Leaves}} ==Heart Events== '''Black Heart Event''' Walk into Romana's Mansion between 7:30pm and 8pm.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/lumina.php Lumina Heart Events] fogu.com When she returns to the inn, enter and you'll see that Lumina and her grandmother Romana are fighting, with Sebastian trying to intervene. Apparently Lumina bought her a back support that Romana hated. They then angrily turn to you, and you have to take a side! Although you might say it's Romana's fault, it really won't increase Lumina's affection. If you blame it on Sebastian, the fight will be resolved and everyone is happy. {{Clr}} ---- '''Purple Heart Event''' Wake up in the morning on a sunny day. Lumina must be at a purple color or higher, and you own the DVD Player and a DVD. The black heart event must have been previously watched.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/lumina.php Lumina Heart Events] fogu.com Lumina has come to visit you early in the morning. She apologizes for coming so early, but heard that you recently got a DVD player! She is really excited and is wondering if she could see it. You can show Lumina the DVD player and she will thank you for showing her. {{Clr}} ---- '''Blue Heart Event''' Exit the Sprite Company Tree between 3:30pm and 6pm on sunny day. Lumina must have a blue heart or higher, and the previous heart events must have been watched.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/lumina.php Lumina Heart Events] fogu.com When you leave the Sprite's tree, you will see Lumina looking around. When you approach her, she explains that she dropped something and asks if you'd help her search for it. Offer to help and the two of you will split up to search for Lumina's necklace. After some searching, you eventually find her necklace and return it to her. She thanks you for being so dependable and goes home. {{Clr}} ---- '''Yellow Heart Event''' Go into Lumina's bedroom between 9pm and 11pm on a sunny day. All previous heart events have also been watched.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/lumina.php Lumina Heart Events] fogu.com Lumina is eagerly looking out her window for [[Van (DS)|Van]]. When you enter, she mistakes you for Van, but is still happy to see you! She explains that she asked Sebastian to order a DVD player from Van after she saw yours. When Van arrives, Lumina asks if she can order a DVD player for herself. Van explains that he has sold out and can't order one for her! Lumina becomes upset and Van takes his leave. To cheer Lumina up, offer to let her come to your house to watch the DVD player any time. Lumina accepts your offer and feels better. ==Rival Heart Events== '''Black Rival Event''' This event can be triggered on a sunny Tuesday between 11am and 1pm at the Goddess Pond by exiting the Sprite tree.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/rock.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Rock and Lumina are together at the Goddess Pond. Rock asks Lumina if she ever liked him in the past. Lumina denies it, but Rock doesn't believe her. Lumina gets flustered and continues to deny it, while Rock just laughs. He tells her that it can be a secret between them. {{Clr}} ---- '''Blue Rival Event''' Go to the beach between 11:10am and 1pm on a Saturday, in Year 2 or later. The first event must have been watched.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/rock.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Rock and Lumina are talking on the beach and Rock tries to compliment Lumina by telling her that she's cute. Lumina isn't impressed and tells him it won't get him a date with her. Rock tells her that he meant she was cute in a "childish" way. Lumina becomes mad at Rock, but he still can't think she's cute, even when she's mad. {{Clr}} ---- '''Green Rival Event''' Exit the Sprite tree between 11am and 1pm on a sunny Tuesday. It must be Year 3 or later, and the previous events must have been watched.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/rock.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Rock and Lumina are at the Goddess Pond together. Rock is reminiscing about a game the two used to play when they were kids. Lumina doesn't remember at first, but Rock reminds her that she used to play as a Goddess and Rock was her servant. Lumina remembers that she fell into the pond one day and Rock jumped in to save her. She thanks Rock for saving her. {{Clr}} ---- '''Orange Rival Event''' The last event can be triggered at the beach between 11:10am and 1pm on a Saturday in Year 4 or later. All previous events must have been watched.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/rock.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Rock sense that something is bothering Lumina, but she won't admit it. She tells Rock to leave him alone. Rock refuses, saying a real man can't leave a girl that likes him alone to cry. Lumina cheers up and admits that being with Rock always makes her forget her worries. Rock teases Lumina by saying that she's fallen in love with him. Lumina admits that she does love him! ==References== {{Reflist|3}} {{HMDSCharacters}} [[Category:Harvest Moon DS]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Bachelorettes]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute Rivals]]
